sources.entry: TextMate - TextMate is a graphical text editor for macOS.

summary.one_liner: TextMate is a graphical text editor for macOS, and this repository holds its source code, which is built with Ninja and a set of C++ dependencies.
summary.what_it_does: The README covers how to get TextMate (a download link is given, though the URL is not included in the text) and how to build it from source. The build uses ./configure to check dependencies and generate a build.ninja file, then ninja to build and sign TextMate.app. It lists dependencies including boost, Cap'n Proto, multimarkdown, ninja, ragel, and sparsehash, which can be installed with Homebrew or MacPorts. The README also describes building and relaunching TextMate from within TextMate itself using the Ninja bundle and the ⌘B shortcut. Feedback goes to a mailing list and an IRC channel.
use_cases: edit plain text and code on a Mac
contribute to a macOS text editor
read the GPL-licensed editor source code
set up a Ninja-based C++ build on macOS
how_to_run: brew install boost capnp google-sparsehash multimarkdown ninja ragel
ninja TextMate  # build and sign only
notable: Builds from source with a generated build.ninja file via ./configure and bin/rave
Can build and relaunch itself from within TextMate using the Ninja bundle and ⌘B
Full session restore makes relaunching safe even with unsaved changes
Source is released under GPL v3 or later
caveats: Targets macOS only, since it is a macOS application (TextMate.app)
Building requires several external dependencies and a git checkout with submodules
The README gives no build status or maintenance information
